name: k5_ca_combination
question: Is the default-target drift carried by the action expert's attention path, and if so by which layer group? Single cross-attention layers were already shown insufficient (0/128). This tests combinations of layers, and segments that include the self-attention layers that also read the prefix.

relation_to_prior_work.stage2q: 8 single CA message swaps, 420 episodes, first-target 0/128 for correct old source
relation_to_prior_work.stage2c: whole-block parameter swaps (front/back half, K/V projections) failed
relation_to_prior_work.k1_k2: output-level: with FT4 common response, any difference term recovers 0
relation_to_prior_work.k4: slot word still attended but its causal weight on the first chunk collapsed in FT4; masking CA text did not change the target

design.intervention: swap the attention block (input_layernorm + self_attn projections) of selected expert layers from the donor model into FT4; the receiver's residual stream, MLP and post-attention norm are untouched
design.why_module_swap: the donor attention is then computed on the receiver's own hidden states at that layer (coupled), which is the V2 semantics; no manual attention math
design.states: R0 rolls 40 native steps from development initial states 4, 6, 8 with instruction A; same noise rule as K4
design.gap_rule: a state is a gap state if native R0 routes both instructions correctly (A->left, B->front) and native FT4 does not (both -> right)
instructions: A = pick up the book and place it in the left compartment of the caddy
B = pick up the book and place it in the front compartment of the caddy

conditions.SELF-ALL: swap all 16 expert attention blocks with FT4's own (identity gate)
conditions.CA-ALL: donor attention at all 8 cross-attention layers
conditions.CA-mismatch: donor attention at layers 1..15 paired with reversed donor layers (same amount of change, wrong correspondence)
conditions.SEG-0-5: donor attention at layers 0-5 (includes self-attention layers)

design.horizon: 400 native steps, continuation starts at step 40, unchanged replanning/noise

endpoints.first_target: first goal entered (lift >3 cm, 5 consecutive steps), k1_geometry
endpoints.D: same state: instruction A first target == left AND instruction B first target == front
endpoints.success: native success predicate step per goal

predictions.P1_gate: SELF-ALL reproduces NAT-FT4 action rows bitwise
predictions.P2_gap: NAT-R0 D=1 and NAT-FT4 D=0 on all three states
predictions.P3_CA_sufficient: CA-ALL reaches D=1 on at least 2 of 3 states
predictions.P4_SA_needed: if CA-ALL stays 0 but SEG-ALL or a segment reaches D>=1, the language path includes self-attention layers
predictions.P5_controls: CA-mismatch does not reach D=1; no condition reaches D=1 by sending both instructions to the same wrong goal

decision_rules.CA-ALL restores: attention messages in the 8 CA layers are sufficient when combined; prune to the minimal group
decision_rules.only SEG-* restores: self-attention layers carry the language path too (collaborator's caveat confirmed)
decision_rules.nothing restores: the default is not carried by the attention modules that can be swapped this way; move to MLP/parameter or data-side causes

exclusions: no episode dropped; failed or non-gap states reported
not_claimed: restoration by intervention is a causal statement about sufficiency in this setting, not a deployable method and not a claim about training causes
